intro.text: Nanha Terith, the darkeyed wife of Hearthstone's baker.

items.text: When Kaladin was thirteen, he overheard Terith gossiping with Relina outside the bakery that Lirin's surgery was unnatural and that he had stolen spheres from Brightlord Wistiow with a forged will. Kaladin glared, and the two women hid in the bakery. Afterwards he called her ignorant to his mother.
